beats: Eight compound words meant eight separate cards, each waiting its turn to come back.
Picking one card, answering, walking back to pick the next ate up the actual drilling time.
Now one card holds the whole set - all eight compound words, or all eight math facts, together.
Each word is still tracked on its own in Supabase, so the due one shows first.
Vocabulary cards go even further - one card now holds ten words at once.
